column1: # Lesson demand and option-shape ratchet per level (#633, #655, #661), checked by `kabar-tools demand --check` in CI.
#   2: max % of listen items with only Arabic options
#   3: max % of multiple-choice items with only Arabic options
#   5..6: % of listen / multiple-choice items where the longest option is the answer, as last recorded
#   7..8: % of listen items where the middle / shortest option is the answer, as last recorded
#   9..10: % of multiple-choice items where the middle / shortest option is the answer, as last recorded
#   11..12: median key length / mean wrong-option length ratio for listen / multiple-choice items
# `-` is no limit (Javanese levels carry only the option-shape columns).
# Rank shares (columns 5..10) must stay inside 25-40% or move toward it; length ratios (columns 11..12) must stay inside 0.90-1.10 or move toward it (#661).
